welcome_page.title: Walking – Comfort
welcome_page.image_alt: #Person walking and a route between two points
welcome_page.description:
Slopes, benches, signs and greenery when you walk.

Taking part is voluntary and you can skip any question. Your answers are not linked to your name, and no public authority receives them.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your submission has been recorded. Thank you for taking the time to complete the questionnaire.

questions.text: Do slopes or hills on your way make walking harder for you?

options.text: No, slopes don't bother me
A little, they make me more tired
Yes, I have to slow down or stop to rest
Yes, I take a flatter route when I can
Yes, there are slopes I can't manage at all
There are no real slopes on my way

questions.text: Do you need benches or places to rest on your way?

options.text: No, I don't need them
Without benches it's less comfortable, but I manage
I use them when I'm tired or carrying heavy bags
I choose routes with benches, even if they are longer
I need them: without benches I can't walk that far

questions.text: How much do street signs help you find your way on foot?
questions.help: Signs include street names, maps and directions, and also audible or tactile information for blind and low-vision people.

options.text: I don't use signs, so they make no difference to me
They help when I need them, and I rarely get lost
I rely on them to find the way, exits and crossings
I often stop to check where I am, because signs are unclear or missing
Signs are so poor that I can only find my way with a phone app

questions.text: Do trees, parks or green spaces change the way you choose to walk?

options.text: No, they make no difference to my route
I like them, but they rarely change my route
Sometimes I choose a greener route
I often choose routes with trees or parks
I go out of my way for greener or nicer routes

questions.text: On hot days, what do you do when you need to walk?

options.text: Nothing changes, the heat doesn't affect me
I suffer the heat, but I go as planned
I go out at cooler times or take shadier streets
I walk less or skip some trips
I don't walk outside in the hottest periods

questions.text: When you walk or use a wheelchair, how do you feel on crowded sidewalks?

options.text: Very uncomfortable
A little uncomfortable
It doesn't bother me
Mostly comfortable
Very comfortable

it.#Do slopes or hills on your way make wal: Le salite lungo la tua strada ti rendono più difficile muoverti?
it.#No, slopes don't bother me: No, le salite non mi danno fastidio
it.#A little, they make me more tired: Un po', mi stancano di più
it.#Yes, I have to slow down or stop to res: Sì, devo rallentare o fermarmi a riposare
it.#Yes, I take a flatter route when I can: Sì, quando posso scelgo un percorso più pianeggiante
it.#Yes, there are slopes I can't manage at: Sì, ci sono salite che non riesco proprio a fare
it.#There are no real slopes on my way: Sul mio percorso non ci sono vere salite
it.#Do you need benches or places to rest o: Hai bisogno di panchine o di posti dove riposare lungo la strada?
it.#Without benches it's less comfortable,: Senza panchine è meno comodo, ma ce la faccio
it.#I use them when I'm tired or carrying h: Le uso quando mi stanco o porto borse pesanti
it.#I choose routes with benches, even if t: Scelgo percorsi con panchine, anche se sono più lunghi
it.#I need them: without benches I can't wa: Mi servono: senza panchine non riesco ad andare così lontano
it.#How much do street signs help you find: Quanto ti aiutano i cartelli stradali a trovare la strada a piedi?
it.#Signs include street names, maps and di: I cartelli comprendono nomi delle strade, mappe e indicazioni, e anche informazioni sonore o tattili per le persone cieche e ipovedenti.
it.#I don't use signs, so they make no diff: Non uso i cartelli, quindi per me non fanno differenza
it.#They help when I need them, and I rarel: Mi aiutano quando servono e mi perdo raramente
it.#I rely on them to find the way, exits a: Mi affido ai cartelli per trovare la strada, le uscite e gli attraversamenti
it.#I often stop to check where I am, becau: Mi fermo spesso a controllare dove sono, perché i cartelli sono poco chiari o mancano
it.#Signs are so poor that I can only find: I cartelli sono così scarsi che trovo la strada solo con un'app sul telefono
it.#Do trees, parks or green spaces change: Alberi, parchi o aree verdi cambiano il modo in cui scegli dove andare a piedi?
it.#No, they make no difference to my route: No, non cambiano il mio percorso
it.#I like them, but they rarely change my: Mi piacciono, ma raramente cambiano il mio percorso
it.#Sometimes I choose a greener route: A volte scelgo un percorso più verde
it.#I often choose routes with trees or par: Scelgo spesso percorsi con alberi o parchi
it.#I go out of my way for greener or nicer: Faccio una deviazione per percorsi più verdi o più belli
it.#On hot days, what do you do when you ne: Nei giorni caldi, cosa fai quando devi spostarti a piedi?
it.#Nothing changes, the heat doesn't affec: Non cambia niente, il caldo non mi dà problemi
it.#I suffer the heat, but I go as planned: Soffro il caldo, ma faccio come previsto
it.#I go out at cooler times or take shadie: Esco nelle ore più fresche o scelgo strade più ombreggiate
it.#I walk less or skip some trips: Cammino meno o salto alcuni spostamenti
it.#I don't walk outside in the hottest per: Non esco a piedi nei periodi più caldi
it.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, how: Quando ti sposti a piedi o in sedia a rotelle, come ti senti sui marciapiedi affollati?
it.#Mostly comfortable: Per lo più a mio agio
it.#Person walking and a route between two: Persona che cammina e un percorso tra due punti
it.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: La tua risposta è stata registrata. Grazie per il tempo dedicato alla compilazione del questionario.
it.#<p>Slopes, benches, signs and greenery:
Pendenze, panchine, segnaletica e verde quando cammini.

La partecipazione è volontaria e puoi saltare qualsiasi domanda. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome e non vengono inviate a nessuna amministrazione pubblica.

fr.#Do slopes or hills on your way make wal: Les pentes ou les côtes sur votre trajet vous compliquent-elles le déplacement ?
fr.#No, slopes don't bother me: Non, les pentes ne me gênent pas
fr.#A little, they make me more tired: Un peu, elles me fatiguent davantage
fr.#Yes, I have to slow down or stop to res: Oui, je dois ralentir ou m'arrêter pour me reposer
fr.#Yes, I take a flatter route when I can: Oui, je prends un trajet plus plat quand je peux
fr.#Yes, there are slopes I can't manage at: Oui, il y a des pentes que je ne peux pas du tout franchir
fr.#There are no real slopes on my way: Il n'y a pas de vraies pentes sur mon trajet
fr.#Do you need benches or places to rest o: Avez-vous besoin de bancs ou d'endroits où vous reposer en chemin ?
fr.#No, I don't need them: Non, je n'en ai pas besoin
fr.#Without benches it's less comfortable,: Sans bancs, c'est moins confortable, mais je me débrouille
fr.#I use them when I'm tired or carrying h: Je les utilise quand je suis fatigué ou que je porte des sacs lourds
fr.#I choose routes with benches, even if t: Je choisis des itinéraires avec des bancs, même s'ils sont plus longs
fr.#I need them: without benches I can't wa: J'en ai besoin : sans bancs, je ne peux pas aller aussi loin
fr.#How much do street signs help you find: Dans quelle mesure les panneaux dans la rue vous aident-ils à trouver votre chemin à pied ?
fr.#Signs include street names, maps and di: Les panneaux comprennent les noms de rues, les plans et les directions, ainsi que des informations sonores ou tactiles pour les personnes aveugles et malvoyantes.
fr.#I don't use signs, so they make no diff: Je n'utilise pas les panneaux, donc cela ne change rien pour moi
fr.#They help when I need them, and I rarel: Ils m'aident quand j'en ai besoin et je me perds rarement
fr.#I rely on them to find the way, exits a: Je m'appuie sur eux pour trouver mon chemin, les sorties et les passages
fr.#I often stop to check where I am, becau: Je m'arrête souvent pour vérifier où je suis, car les panneaux sont peu clairs ou absents
fr.#Signs are so poor that I can only find: Les panneaux sont si mauvais que je ne trouve mon chemin qu'avec une appli sur mon téléphone
fr.#Do trees, parks or green spaces change: Les arbres, les parcs ou les espaces verts changent-ils la façon dont vous choisissez votre chemin à pied ?
fr.#No, they make no difference to my route: Non, ils ne changent rien à mon itinéraire
fr.#I like them, but they rarely change my: Je les aime, mais ils changent rarement mon itinéraire
fr.#Sometimes I choose a greener route: Je choisis parfois un itinéraire plus vert
fr.#I often choose routes with trees or par: Je choisis souvent des itinéraires avec des arbres ou des parcs
fr.#I go out of my way for greener or nicer: Je fais un détour pour des itinéraires plus verts ou plus agréables
fr.#On hot days, what do you do when you ne: Les jours de chaleur, que faites-vous quand vous devez vous déplacer à pied ?
fr.#Nothing changes, the heat doesn't affec: Rien ne change, la chaleur ne m'affecte pas
fr.#I suffer the heat, but I go as planned: Je souffre de la chaleur, mais je fais comme prévu
fr.#I go out at cooler times or take shadie: Je sors aux heures plus fraîches ou je prends des rues plus ombragées
fr.#I walk less or skip some trips: Je marche moins ou je saute certains trajets
fr.#I don't walk outside in the hottest per: Je ne marche pas dehors aux heures les plus chaudes
fr.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, how: Lorsque vous marchez ou vous déplacez en fauteuil roulant, que ressentez-vous sur les trottoirs bondés ?
fr.#Person walking and a route between two: Personne à pied et un itinéraire entre deux points
fr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Votre réponse a bien été enregistrée. Merci d’avoir pris le temps de remplir ce questionnaire.
fr.#<p>Slopes, benches, signs and greenery:
Les pentes, les bancs, la signalisation et la verdure lorsque vous marchez.

La participation est volontaire et vous pouvez passer n’importe quelle question. Vos réponses ne sont pas associées à votre nom et ne sont transmises à aucune administration.

fa.#Do slopes or hills on your way make wal: آیا شیب یا سربالایی در مسیرتان راه رفتن را برای شما سخت‌تر می‌کند؟
fa.#Yes, I have to slow down or stop to res: بله، باید آهسته بروم یا برای استراحت بایستم
fa.#Yes, I take a flatter route when I can: بله، هر وقت بتوانم از مسیر هموارتر می‌روم
fa.#Yes, there are slopes I can't manage at: بله، شیب‌هایی هست که اصلاً از پس آن‌ها برنمی‌آیم
fa.#There are no real slopes on my way: در مسیر من شیب واقعی وجود ندارد
fa.#Do you need benches or places to rest o: آیا در مسیرتان به نیمکت یا جای استراحت نیاز دارید؟
fa.#Without benches it's less comfortable,: بدون نیمکت کمتر راحت است، اما از پسش برمی‌آیم
fa.#I use them when I'm tired or carrying h: وقتی خسته‌ام یا کیسه سنگین دارم از آن‌ها استفاده می‌کنم
fa.#I choose routes with benches, even if t: مسیرهایی را انتخاب می‌کنم که نیمکت دارند، حتی اگر طولانی‌تر باشند
fa.#I need them: without benches I can't wa: به آن‌ها نیاز دارم: بدون نیمکت نمی‌توانم این‌قدر راه بروم
fa.#How much do street signs help you find: تابلوها و علامت‌های خیابان چقدر به شما کمک می‌کنند در پیاده‌روی راه را پیدا کنید؟
fa.#Signs include street names, maps and di: علامت‌ها شامل نام خیابان، نقشه و جهت‌ها هستند و همچنین اطلاعات صوتی یا لمسی برای نابینایان و کم‌بینایان.
fa.#I don't use signs, so they make no diff: از علامت‌ها استفاده نمی‌کنم، پس برایم فرقی ندارند
fa.#They help when I need them, and I rarel: وقتی لازم دارم کمک می‌کنند و به‌ندرت راه را گم می‌کنم
fa.#I rely on them to find the way, exits a: برای پیدا کردن راه، خروجی‌ها و گذرگاه‌ها به آن‌ها تکیه می‌کنم
fa.#I often stop to check where I am, becau: اغلب می‌ایستم تا ببینم کجا هستم، چون علامت‌ها نامشخص است یا نیست
fa.#Signs are so poor that I can only find: علامت‌ها آن‌قدر ضعیف است که فقط با اپلیکیشن تلفن راه را پیدا می‌کنم
fa.#Do trees, parks or green spaces change: آیا درخت، پارک یا فضای سبز شیوه انتخاب مسیر پیاده‌روی شما را تغییر می‌دهد؟
fa.#No, they make no difference to my route: نه، بر مسیر من اثری ندارند
